description.narrative: THE PROGRAM INCLUDES A SET OF ACTIVITIES TO SUPPORT THE HEALTH REFORM PROGRAM, IMPROVE EFFICIENCY, USE AND AVAILABILITY OF RESOURCES TO THE SECTOR AS WELL AS PRIORITY INVESTMENTS TO INCREASE QUALITY AND COVERAGE OF HEALTH SERVICES IN THE COUNTRY TO AN ACCEPTABLE LEVEL. THROUGH (1) REORGANIZATION AND REGULATION OF THE SECTOR, (2) SUPPORT THE REFORM OF PRIMARY SERVICES DELIVERY (3) HOSPITAL REFORM, AND (4) REHABILITATION OF ONE HOSPITAL.
